notes: A Metromoney card costs 2 GEL (metro, bus and cable car rides 1 GEL); Bolt taxis are cheap. Airport bus 337. For Kazbegi and Kakheti, take a tour (Gamarjoba, Budget Georgia about 80-100 GEL) or a marshrutka.
In summer the city reaches 30-35°C, while Kazbegi is cooler at 15-20°C and Gergeti can be foggy. Tbilisoba is in October, and Rtveli (grape harvest) is in September and October in Kakheti.

Turkish citizens enter with an ID card (1 year visa-free). Carry cash in GEL (ATMs), though cards are widely accepted. Khinkali costs 1 GEL each, khachapuri 12-18 GEL, a glass of wine 8 GEL and a bathhouse 50-100 GEL; tip 10%.
Call ahead to book a private bathhouse room (Chreli Abano). For Gergeti, haggle for a 4x4 in town. Sighnaghi is full at weekends.
Expect a supra (feast) and a tamada (toastmaster). 'Gaumarjos' means cheers. Hold khinkali by the top, sip the broth and leave the top.
Kvevri amber wine (UNESCO), chacha (grape brandy), churchkhela, tkemali plum sauce and pkhali.

stops.name: Meidan & Sioni Katedrali
stops.tips: The heart of the old city: St Nino's hanging cross and Shardeni Street.

stops.name: Narikala Fortress Cable Car
stops.tips: Take the cable car from Rike Park (Metromoney card). You'll find a 4th-century fortress, the Mother of Georgia statue and views over the Kura.

stops.name: Abanotubani Sulphur Baths
stops.tips: 17th-century brick-domed bathhouses (Pushkin bathed here too). A private room costs 50-100 GEL, scrub included. The Orbeliani facade is blue and looks like a mosque.

stops.name: Café Leila Old Town
stops.tips: Vegetarian Georgian food: try the pkhali and lobio. On King Erekle Street.

stops.name: Bridge of Peace & Rike Park
stops.tips: The glass bridge is lit up at night, over the Kura River.

backups.name: Shavi Lomi
backups.tips: An art-filled home restaurant serving modern Georgian cooking.

backups.name: Leghvtakhevi Waterfall
backups.tips: A waterfall behind the bathhouse district. Free; a good alternative to a garden.

stops.name: Rustaveli Avenue
stops.tips: Parliament, the Opera and the Rustaveli Theatre, in Soviet and art nouveau styles.

stops.name: Georgian National Museum
stops.tips: The Colchis gold treasure and the Museum of Soviet Occupation, plus the Dmanisi skulls (1.8 million years old).

stops.name: Dry Bridge Market
stops.tips: A flea market selling Soviet medals, glass, kilims and paintings. It runs every day and gets bigger at weekends.

stops.name: Barbarestan
stops.tips: Recipes from a 19th-century cookbook. Book ahead. On Aghmashenebeli Avenue.

stops.name: Vino Underground Natural Wine
stops.tips: A wine bar for kvevri (clay jar) amber wine, an 8,000-year-old tradition. Tastings available.

backups.name: Fabrika Tbilisi
backups.tips: A hipster courtyard in a former Soviet sewing factory, with graffiti and cafés.

backups.name: Sofia Melnikova's Fantastic Douqan
backups.tips: In the garden of the Writers' House; try the khachapuri (cheese-filled bread).

stops.name: Jvari Monastery
stops.tips: A 6th-century Holy Cross monastery with Lermontov's view of the meeting point of two rivers (Aragvi and Kura). 30 minutes by taxi or marshrutka (minibus).

stops.name: Svetitskhoveli Cathedral
stops.tips: An 11th-century UNESCO cathedral with the legend of Christ's robe and royal tombs. Head covering required.

stops.name: Salobie Bia Mtskheta
stops.tips: Lobio (bean stew) in a clay pot and mchadi (cornbread): a Mtskheta classic.

stops.name: Samtavro Monastery
stops.tips: St Nino's blackberry bush; home to nuns.

stops.name: Chronicle of Georgia
stops.tips: On the way back, see Tsereteli's giant stone monument, with views of the Tbilisi Sea.

backups.name: Shio-Mgvime Monastery
backups.tips: A 6th-century canyon monastery; an alternative to Samtavro.

backups.name: Chateau Mukhrani
backups.tips: Wine tasting and lunch at a princely château, 30 minutes from Mtskheta.

stops.name: Ananuri Fortress
stops.tips: On the Georgian Military Road (3 hours; tour about 80 GEL). A 17th-century fortress above the Zhinvali Reservoir.

stops.name: Gudauri Panorama Russia-Georgia Friendship Monument
stops.tips: A semicircle with Soviet mosaics at 2,400 m, with valley views and paragliding.

stops.name: Gergeti Trinity Church
stops.tips: A 14th-century church at 2,170 m, facing Mount Kazbek (5,047 m). Go by 4x4 (60 GEL) or on a 1.5-hour climb.

stops.name: Stepantsminda
stops.tips: Lunch on mountain khinkali (Mtiuluri, dumplings) in the town.

stops.name: Stepantsminda Kazbek View
stops.tips: The Rooms Hotel terrace. The return takes 3 hours, with a stop in Pasanauri.

backups.name: Truso Valley
backups.tips: Ghost villages with mineral springs; an extra walk (if you're not on a tour).

backups.name: Pasanauri
backups.tips: The town where khinkali was born; stop on the way back.

stops.name: Bodbe Monastery
stops.tips: 2 hours to Sighnaghi (tour about 100 GEL). St Nino's tomb, cypresses and the Alazani Valley.

stops.name: Sighnaghi
stops.tips: The walled 'city of love', with Caucasus views, a wedding registry office open 24 hours and a Pirosmani museum.

stops.name: Pheasant's Tears
stops.tips: Natural kvevri wines and lunch at John Wurdeman's vineyard, with tastings.

stops.name: Kindzmarauli Corporation
stops.tips: A kvevri wine factory in Kvareli. Tastings, and the semi-sweet red.

stops.name: Telavi & Alaverdi Monastery
stops.tips: The main town of Telavi and the 11th-century Alaverdi Cathedral (50 m high); then the return.

backups.name: Khareba Winery Tunnel
backups.tips: A 7 km wine tunnel inside the mountain, in Kvareli.

backups.name: Tsinandali Estate
backups.tips: A princely estate and garden; an alternative to Telavi.

stops.name: Sololaki Courtyards
stops.tips: Art nouveau entrances and wooden balconies; the Kalantarov house and the Betlemi stairs.

stops.name: Mother of Georgia
stops.tips: The aluminium mother on Sololaki hill, holding wine and a sword.

stops.name: Mtatsminda Funicular & Pantheon
stops.tips: Ride the funicular up to 770 m. See Griboyedov and the writers' pantheon, plus St David's Church.

stops.name: Funicular Restaurant Mtatsminda
stops.tips: Try the lobiani and Acharuli khachapuri (boat-shaped). City panorama and famous ponchiki (doughnuts).

stops.name: Vake Park & Turtle Lake
stops.tips: A park with a victory monument. Take the cable car to Turtle Lake and rent a boat on the lake.

backups.name: Open Air Museum of Ethnography
backups.tips: An open-air museum of Georgian houses beside Turtle Lake.

backups.name: Café Stamba
backups.tips: A stylish café in a Soviet printing house, in Vera.

days.theme: Dezerter Bazaar and a light farewell

stops.name: Dezerter Bazaar
stops.tips: A huge local market by the railway station: churchkhela, suluguni, tkemali and spices.

stops.name: Holy Trinity Cathedral of Tbilisi
stops.tips: The Holy Trinity Cathedral (2004): 87 m tall, with a golden dome, on Avlabari hill.

stops.name: Machakhela Avlabari
stops.tips: An Adjarian khachapuri chain; a farewell meal.

stops.name: Airport Bus 337 Freedom Square
stops.tips: Bus 337 takes 40 minutes (Metromoney), or take a Bolt for 30 GEL. Farewell.

backups.name: Metekhi Church & Vakhtang Gorgasali
backups.tips: A church and a king's statue on a rock; an alternative to the cathedral.

backups.name: Puri Guliani Bakery
backups.tips: Bread from a tone (clay oven) and lobiani; street side.
